forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {語|かた}らっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to converse; to talk together; to share stories
definitions.explanation: To engage in warm, unhurried conversation, often with a sense of intimacy or emotional depth.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{語|かた}らった。
examples.english: We talked about the future late into the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{語|かた}らって⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent an enjoyable time sharing old memories with an old friend I hadn't seen in a long time.

notes:
{語|かた}らう is an intransitive godan verb that conveys a warm, leisurely quality of conversation. It is more literary and poetic than ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ or ⟦しゃべる→しゃべる：02117_shaberu⟧.

ASPECT (ている):
{語|かた}らって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{語|かた}らう (converse with X)
- X⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{語|かた}らう (talk about X)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{友|とも}→友：03466_tomo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{語|かた}らう (talk with friends)
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{語|かた}らう (share one's dreams)
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{語|かた}らう (talk over drinks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語|かた}らう vs ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: {語|かた}らう implies unhurried, heartfelt conversation, while ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ is a neutral, general word for speaking or talking.
- {語|かた}らう vs ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ means to narrate or tell a story (often one-directional), while {語|かた}らう implies mutual, back-and-forth exchange.
